introduce: Start in the push-up position. Bend your right knee towards your chest and keep your left leg straight, then quickly switch from one leg to the other. \n\nThis exercise strengthens multiple muscle groups.
name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBER

tips.text: We suggest you do this on a mat.
Bring your knees as close to your chest as possible.
Don't lift your hips up.
Take steady and deep breaths.
If you feel it's too easy, do it as fast as you can.
If you feel it's too hard, adjust to a speed that makes you feel comfortable.
If you feel it's too hard, elevate your hands on a bench.
This is a great full body exercise.
This can strengthen your cardiovascular system.

introduce:
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and your hands on your hips. 

Take a step forward with your right leg and lower your body until your right thigh is parallel with the floor. 

Then return and switch to the other leg. This exercise strengthens the quadriceps, gluteus maximus and hamstrings.
name: LUNGES

tips.text: Take a big step forward.
Keep your legs at a 90 degree angle.
Keep your weight on your heels when pushing your body up.
Don't let your front knee go over your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
Enlarge the distance between your feet if your knees are sore.
All of your leg muscles should be engaged.

introduce: Lie down on your side with your head rested on your left arm. Lift your upper leg up and return to the start position.\n\nMake sure your right leg goes straight up and down during the exercise. It\'s a great exercise for the gluteus.
name: SIDE-LYING LEG LIFT RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Your leg should go straight up and down.
Keep your legs straight.
Your toes should point forward.
Don't rotate your leg forward or backward.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering.
To get more of a challenge, add weight on your ankle.
Hold for a few seconds when lifting your leg.
This is a great exercise for your glutes and quadriceps.

introduce:
Lie down on your side with your head rested on your right arm. Lift your upper leg up and return to the start position.

Make sure your left leg goes straight up and down during the exercise.

It's a great exercise for the gluteus.
name: SIDE-LYING LEG LIFT LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Your leg should go straight up and down.
Keep your legs straight.
Your toes should point forward.
Don't rotate your leg forward or backward.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering.
To get more of a challenge, add weight on your ankle.
Hold for a few seconds when lifting your leg.
This is a great exercise for your glutes and quadriceps.

introduce: Lie on your back with your arms at your sides. Lift your legs and keep them as straight as you can. \n\nThen quickly raise your right leg up, and simultaneously lower your left leg. Switch legs and repeat.
name: FLUTTER KICKS

tips.text: Please do this exercise on a mat.
Keep your legs as straight as you can.
Make sure your back is flat against the floor.
Tighten your core.
Breathe regularly.
Your lower back should not feel sore.
This exercise targets the abs and legs.
This exercise can increase core strength and improve your endurance.

introduce: Stand with your right hand on the wall. Bend your left leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your left calf close to your left thigh. Hold this position.
name: LEFT QUAD STRETCH WITH WALL

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your upper body straight during the exercise.
Your lifted knee should always go straight down.
This exercise can stretch your quadriceps.

introduce: Stand with your left hand on the wall. Bend your right leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your right calf close to your right thigh. Hold this position.
name: RIGHT QUAD STRETCH WITH WALL

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please keep your upper body straight during the exercise.
Your lifted knee should always go straight down.
This exercise can stretch your quadriceps.

introduce: Lie on your back with your legs lifted, knees bent and heels squeezed together. Put your arms flat at your sides. \n\nStraighten your legs and bring them back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.
name: FROG PRESS

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please do it slowly to get better results.
Your lower back shouldn’t feel strained.
Exhale when straightening your legs, and inhale when bringing them back.
This exercise really tightens your inner thighs.

introduce: Start in the straight arm plank position with your hands under your shoulders and feet together.\n\nHop your feet apart and land on your toes, then hop back. Repeat the exercise.
name: PLANK JACKS

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your upper body stable.
Your body should be in a straight line.
Don't sink or raise your hips.
It is a good exercise for your abs, core, shoulders, and lower back.
